mandate: C327 — test the cross-sectional intraday SIGNED JUMP-VARIATION (DISCONTINUITY) SEASONAL DISLOCATION mean-reversion statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (864 pre-registered configs). Per bar-of-day bucket, trailing L same-tod occurrences: RV=sum(r^2), BV=(pi/2)*sum(|r_t||r_{t-1}|), JV=max(RV-BV,0), sjv=sign(sum(r*|r|))*JV, jv_ratio=JV/RV, rv_bv=RV/BV; score=-dislocation vs trailing same-tod mean. Signals: sjv_dev, jv_ratio_dev, rv_bv_dev. Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and jump-variation-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: denominators/values<=0 -> NaN; same-tod trailing stats NaN-aware min_periods=L excluding NaN obs; zero-variance/insufficient-obs NaNs fail-closed (NaN bars weight 0); raw cache fields are zero-NaN real derivations.

data_quality.note: jump-stat NaN share is dominated by structural warmup (first ~L same-tod occurrences per bucket) plus denominator<=0 windows; zero-variance adds negligible mass.

methodology.buckets: bar-of-day (tod)=seconds-of-day//300 (0..287), exact 288 bars per UTC day.
methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; r2=r^2, abs_r=|r|, signed_r2=r*|r|, bipower=|r_t|*|r_{t-1}| (bipower[0]=0). Zero NaN raw fields.
methodology.signals: per bar-of-day bucket over trailing L same-tod bars: RV=sum(r2), BV=(pi/2)*sum(bipower), JV=max(RV-BV,0), sjv=sign(sum(signed_r2))*JV, jv_ratio=JV/RV (NaN if RV<=0), rv_bv=RV/BV (NaN if BV<=0). score=-(v-trailing_mean_L(v@tod)); causal shift(1), cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 864 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config signal nets vs sjv_placebo (per-asset permuted returns, same positions); shares=|net|/sum(|buckets|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
